spec_match.rationale: Runs the real requestDevice → gatt.connect → server.addEventListener path the feature exists for, guards the server-level attach on instanceof EventTarget, and keeps gattserverdisconnected on the device per the unchanged spec.

interactive.rationale: Two live buttons drive the actual API; readout cards, a capped event log and an outcome region update from real connection state, and the disconnect button calls gatt.disconnect().

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises the real flow with the exact exception surfaced; the page names each DOMException and maps it to a cause.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles API-absent (attempt reports honestly instead of throwing), insecure context, pre-157 server (attach skipped and logged), chooser dismissal as NotFoundError-is-normal, and adapter-absent.

references.rationale: chromestatus 5138797158334464, PR 672 preview, sibling feature's MTU probe and adjacent concepts are all linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's manual assertion records that instance dispatch needs hardware plus a gesture and points at this page; the requestDevice gesture contract is covered in the sibling feature's suite rather than duplicated.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 has no Web Bluetooth and no adapter: load, support panel, pair-click unavailable branch, log line and re-enabled button were all verified (screenshots + same-origin driver + clean console), but the connected-device path cannot be exercised in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts fire for the support probe, the unavailable branch, pair-ended with the DOMException name, successful connect and server-event delivery.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; secondary button overrides background and color together; disabled state dims without removing the control.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible focus, dl/dt/dd readouts, the event log is an aria-live labelled list, and the outcome region is aria-live polite text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: scrollWidth 360 at a 360px viewport; readout cards reflow via auto-fit minmax(150px,1fr); buttons are 44px; verified by screenshot at 500px and 1280px.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the connected path against real BLE hardware on Chrome 157
openQuestions.detail: With an adapter and a device in range on a 157 build, verify: server.addEventListener attaches without the skip branch, the readout shows 'attached (server)', gatt.disconnect() fires gattserverdisconnected on the device, and — behind --enable-blink-features=WebBluetoothMaxWriteWithoutResponseSize once CL 7879985 lands — a real maxwritewithoutresponsesizechanged delivery appears in the log.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates with aria-live regions for async operations
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async state changes through live regions and keep error feedback textual and specific rather than visual-only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The event log (aria-live polite, aria-label) and outcome output announce every connection state change; failures render the exact DOMException name and a plain-language mapping.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls layout without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping flex rows for control groups and auto-fit grids for stat cards so narrow viewports reflow instead of overflowing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls are a wrapping flex row and readouts an auto-fit grid; measured overflow-free at 360px.

summary: The practical page: real API calls behind a user gesture with every failure mode surfaced by name. In this headless Linux Chromium the honest unavailable branch was exercised end-to-end (button press included); the hardware path is documented as the remaining verification on real 157 hardware.
